proposed_first_batch.selection_rule: Originally missing rows with current Workflows resource and JSON Config declarations; exclude already-present 1621455, archive-only sources and all prior 403 sources. Two sources only; no fallback reselection.
proposed_first_batch.eligible_file_rule: New single metadata response must match fixed numeric resource ID and Workflows type; file extension JSON and type Config, with positive numeric version/file IDs. No original IDs are recorded for these two missing rows. Choose minimum numeric (version ID, file ID) tuple among eligible entries before any file GET; no second candidate if failure or non-graph.
proposed_first_batch.file_url_rule: Use only selected metadata entry public HTTPS exact download URL in memory; never output it. No cookies, credentials, token, challenge, login or automatic redirect. Redirect/non-200/non-JSON-like content closes that source without a replacement GET.
proposed_first_batch.json_acceptance: Bound stream before append. Require UTF-8 with optional BOM, first non-whitespace byte object/array marker, then full bounded JSON parse and structural static ComfyUI API/frontend graph validation without imports/execution. Config-only JSON is not accepted as a graph.
proposed_first_batch.storage_if_later_authorized: New isolated private supplemental directory only, generated neutral IDs; no overwrite of historical graph/truth/current75, no prompt/model names in public projection. Keep new delivered-file raw SHA and canonical algorithm SHA separately.
proposed_first_batch.identity_limit: Missing rows have only 12-hex canonical identity prefixes and no full raw SHA or original file/version IDs. A new same-source valid graph is an independent supplement. Do not call it original raw-byte recovery or replace missing counts/oracles without a separately justified identity proof.

json.magic: UTF-8 optional BOM then object/array start; full bounded parse required

png.guard: Bound chunks and dimensions; inspect only workflow metadata, never render image; cap metadata decompression at 2MiB.

webp.magic: RIFF length and WEBP container signatures
webp.guard: Validate declared RIFF length and chunk bounds; inspect only workflow metadata, no pixel decode; decoded metadata max2MiB.

zip.magic: PK local or empty central-directory signatures
zip.guard: Central-directory validation only before member read; reject encrypted/symlink/path traversal/absolute entries, model or executable members. No extraction to disk or model loading; at most one JSON member read, <=2MiB and declared total<=16MiB, compression ratio<=100 and <=64 entries.

future_format_guards_not_authorized_this.unknown_binary_or_model_weight: Reject immediately; no attempt to infer a workflow from model binaries.
